title: Chilli Crisp Pickle-Brined Fried Chicken Sandwiches
changes_from_base: Thighs soak in dill pickle brine with garlic and mustard powder, then a craggy flour-cornflour dredge with more brine, are deep-fried and tossed in chilli crisp mayonnaise, and topped with a quick sesame cucumber pickle instead of lettuce.
summary: Brined chicken thighs are coated in a crispy, garlic-spiked crust, then tossed in a fiery chilli-mayo and served in soft buns with cooling sesame-spiked cucumber pickle.
equipment: wire rack set in a rimmed baking tray

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
cucumber, halved lengthways and thinly sliced
boneless, skinless chicken thighs (85-140 g each), trimmed
dill pickle brine (from a jar of dill pickles), divided
sprigs fresh dill, plus 2 tbsp chopped dill for the coating
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Pickle
steps.text: Heat 120 ml rice vinegar, 1 tbsp caster sugar, 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil, 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp fine salt in the microwave for 1-2 minutes, stirring until the sugar dissolves. Pour this over the sliced cucumber and leave to cool, then chill for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Brine
steps.text: Mix 4 chicken thighs with 240 ml dill pickle brine, 8 sprigs dill, 6 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp mustard powder, 1½ tsp fine salt and 1½ tsp ground black pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 6-12 hours until the chicken has absorbed the flavours.

steps.title: Coating
steps.text: Whisk together 175 g plain flour, 65 g cornflour, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp chopped dill and the remaining 2 tsp mustard powder, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Rub in the remaining 60 ml brine with your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs with small craggy bits.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Lift each thigh from the brine and discard the liquid, then press each one into the coating on all sides. Set on a wire rack and chill for 30 minutes to 2 hours.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Heat 750 ml vegetable oil in a large casserole to 175 °C, then fry the chicken for 8-12 minutes, turning halfway through, until golden brown and the thickest part reaches 74 °C inside. Keep the oil temperature between 165 and 175 °C throughout. Drain the fried chicken on kitchen paper.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Whisk together 120 g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp chilli crisp, 1 tbsp water and ¼ tsp caster sugar in a bowl. Toss each piece of chicken in this mixture until well coated.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Place each chicken piece in a split burger bun and top with some of the drained sesame pickle.

tips: Keep the oil temperature steady between 165 and 175 °C to ensure the coating crisps up without burning and the chicken cooks through evenly.
Chill the coated chicken for at least 30 minutes before frying; the cold coating fries up crispier.
Chilli crisp can contain soya, sesame or peanuts, so check the label; the pickle can be made up to a week ahead.

Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
storage: The sesame pickle keeps refrigerated for up to 1 week; the finished sandwich is best enjoyed immediately. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
